verifications.claim: The last day to file 2025 federal income tax returns is Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'For 2025 returns filed in 2026, the last day to file taxes is April 15, 2026.'; R2: 'The deadline to file taxes is Wednesday, April 15'; R6: 'Taxpayers have until Wednesday, April 15, 2026, to file their 2025 tax returns'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state April 15, 2026 as the deadline for 2025 returns, with R2 and R6 specifying Wednesday.

verifications.claim: Electronic returns must be submitted by midnight in your time zone on April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'If you file online or through tax software... transmitted on or before midnight on Tax Day'; 'midnight on April 15 in the time zone you’re in.'; R8: 'taxes must be submitted electronically before midnight in your time zone.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state electronic filing deadline is midnight local time zone on April 15.

verifications.claim: Paper returns must be postmarked by April 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'If you file via mail, the IRS will consider your return filed on time if it was postmarked by the due date.'; R8: 'your taxes will need to be taken to the post office... to have an April 15, 2026, postmark.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for postmark by April 15 for paper returns.

verifications.claim: Payment is due on April 15, 2026 if you owe taxes, regardless of an extension.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'payments are due on Tax Day'; R4: 'pay your tax bill by April 15, 2026'; R5: 'Taxes are still owed by April 15'; R9: 'even if you choose to file an extension, you are still required to pay any taxes you may owe by the April deadline.'
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources that payment due April 15 regardless of filing extension.

verifications.claim: Filing Form 4868 by April 15, 2026 grants an automatic extension until October 15, 2026 to file the return.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'submit IRS Form 4868... by the original due date... due date to file with extension is Oct. 15.'; R2: 'file Form 4868... until Oct. 15'; similar in others.
verifications.reasoning: Exact details on Form 4868 providing automatic extension to Oct 15 if filed by April 15.

verifications.claim: The automatic extension from Form 4868 does not delay payment obligations.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'an extension only gives you more time to submit your tax return forms, not more time to pay your taxes.'; R5: 'an extension to file is not an extension to pay taxes.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state extension does not extend payment deadline.

verifications.claim: The IRS Free File program can be used to prepare and e-file returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'use IRS Free File at IRS.gov/freefile to request an automatic six-month tax-filing extension.'; R6: 'IRS Free File program will begin accepting individual tax returns'; R7: 'prepare and file federal income tax returns for free online, using guided tax preparation software through IRS Free File.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of IRS Free File for preparing and e-filing.

verifications.claim: H&R Block can be used to prepare and e-file returns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'File with H&R Block to get your max refund'; 'e-file an extension using our tax software or online tax filing program.'; R5: 'Carl Breedlove, principal tax research analyst at H&R Block.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 is H&R Block site promoting their services for filing and e-filing.

verifications.claim: Late filing penalties can reach 5% of unpaid taxes per month, up to 25%.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'late filing penalty is 5% of the additional taxes owed... up to a maximum of 25%.'; R5: '5% of the tax owed each month... up to a maximum of 25%.'

verifications.claim: Free assistance is available through VITA/TCE/AARP Tax-Aide sites.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'IRS-certified volunteers. The Volunteer Income Tax Assistance and Tax Counseling for the Elderly programs'; R7: 'VITA, TCE, or AARP Tax-Aide sites'; 'free programs have operated for more than 50 years.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct reference to free assistance via these exact programs.

verifications.claim: The deadline to file 2025 federal income tax returns for those living outside the United States and Puerto Rico is June 15, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'June 15 — File tax Form 1040... if you’re a U.S. citizen, resident alien, or you’re an active military member living and working outside the U.S. and Puerto Rico.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 exactly matches the claim, including locations.
